subtopic: Integrals of the Type (px+q) over a Quadratic
solution:
Write the numerator as \(2x-3 = A\,\frac{d}{dx}(3x^2+4x+5) + B\)
\(2x-3 = A(6x+4)+B = (6A)x + (4A+B)\)
Comparing the coefficients of like variables and constants: \(6A=2\) and \(4A+B=-3\)
\(\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{3}\) and \(B=-\frac{13}{3}\)
\(\therefore \int \frac{2x-3}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx = \frac{1}{3}\int \frac{6x+4}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx - \frac{13}{3}\int \frac{1}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx = I_1 - I_2\) ..... (i)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{3}\int \frac{6x+4}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx\); put \(3x^2+4x+5=t\), \(\therefore (6x+4)\,dx = dt\)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{3}\int \frac{1}{t}\, dt = \frac{1}{3}\log t + c_1 = \frac{1}{3}\log(3x^2+4x+5) + c_1\) ..... (ii)
\(I_2 = \frac{13}{3}\int \frac{1}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx = \frac{13}{9}\int \frac{1}{x^2+\frac{4}{3}x+\frac{5}{3}}\, dx = \frac{13}{9}\int \frac{1}{\left(x+\frac{2}{3}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\sqrt{11}}{3}\right)^2}\, dx\)
Using \(\int \frac{1}{x^2+a^2}\, dx = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + c\),
\(I_2 = \frac{13}{9}\cdot\frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{11}}{3}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x+\frac{2}{3}}{\frac{\sqrt{11}}{3}}\right) + c_2 = \frac{13}{3\sqrt{11}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x+2}{\sqrt{11}}\right) + c_2\) ..... (iii)
Thus, from (i), (ii) and (iii),
\(\int \frac{2x-3}{3x^2+4x+5}\, dx = \frac{1}{3}\log(3x^2+4x+5) - \frac{13}{3\sqrt{11}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x+2}{\sqrt{11}}\right) + c\)  \(\ (\because c_1 + c_2 = c)\)

subtopic: Integrals of the Type (px+q) over a Quadratic
solution:
\(I = \int \sqrt{\frac{(x-5)(x-5)}{(x-7)(x-5)}}\, dx = \int \sqrt{\frac{(x-5)^2}{x^2-12x+35}}\, dx\)
Write \(x-5 = A\,\frac{d}{dx}(x^2-12x+35) + B\)
\(x-5 = A(2x-12)+B = (2A)x + (-12A+B)\)
Comparing the coefficients of like variables and constants: \(2A=1\) and \(-12A+B=-5\)
\(\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{2}\) and \(B=1\)
\(I = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2x-12}{\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}}\, dx + \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}}\, dx = I_1 + I_2\) ..... (i)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2x-12}{\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}}\, dx\); put \(x^2-12x+35=t\), \(\therefore (2x-12)\,dx = dt\)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{t}}\, dt = \int \frac{1}{2\sqrt{t}}\, dt = \sqrt{t} + c_1 = \sqrt{x^2-12x+35} + c_1\) ..... (ii)
\(I_2 = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}}\, dx = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2-12x+36-1}}\, dx = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{(x-6)^2-(1)^2}}\, dx\)
Using \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2-a^2}}\, dx = \log\left(x+\sqrt{x^2-a^2}\right) + c\),
\(I_2 = \log\left((x-6)+\sqrt{(x-6)^2-1}\right) + c_2 = \log\left((x-6)+\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}\right) + c_2\) ..... (iii)
Thus, from (i), (ii) and (iii),
\(\int \sqrt{\frac{x-5}{x-7}}\, dx = \sqrt{x^2-12x+35} + \log\left((x-6)+\sqrt{x^2-12x+35}\right) + c\)  \(\ (c_1 + c_2 = c)\)

subtopic: Integrals of the Type (px+q) over a Quadratic
solution:
Rationalise by multiplying numerator and denominator inside the root by \((8-x)\):
\(= \int \sqrt{\frac{(8-x)}{x}\times\frac{(8-x)}{(8-x)}}\, dx = \int \sqrt{\frac{(8-x)^2}{8x-x^2}}\, dx = \int \frac{(8-x)}{\sqrt{8x-x^2}}\, dx\)
Write \(8-x = A\,\frac{d}{dx}(8x-x^2) + B\)
\(8-x = A(8-2x) + B = (8A+B) - 2Ax\)
Comparing the coefficients of like variables and constants: \(8A+B=8\) and \(-2A=-1\)
\(\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{2}\) and \(B=4\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{8-2x}{\sqrt{8x-x^2}}\, dx + 4\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{8x-x^2}}\, dx = I_1 + I_2\) ..... (i)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{8-2x}{\sqrt{8x-x^2}}\, dx\); put \(8x-x^2 = t\), \(\therefore (8-2x)\,dx = dt\)
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{t}}\, dt = \sqrt{t} + c_1 = \sqrt{8x-x^2} + c_1\) ..... (ii)
\(I_2 = 4\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{8x-x^2}}\, dx = 4\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{-(x^2-8x)}}\, dx = 4\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{16-(x-4)^2}}\, dx\)
Using \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}\, dx = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right) + c\) with \(a=4\),
\(I_2 = 4\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x-4}{4}\right) + c_2\) ..... (iii)
Thus, from (i), (ii) and (iii),
\(\int \sqrt{\frac{8-x}{x}}\, dx = \sqrt{8x-x^2} + 4\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x-4}{4}\right) + c\)  \(\ (\because c_1 + c_2 = c)\)
